session_title: Ambitious plans versus the harsh reality.

content.text: Recently, I've been reading some materials, and it turns out that running is truly the most cost-effective exercise. It doesn’t require much extra spending and offers tremendous benefits for the body.
That's true. I've been under a lot of stress at work lately and feeling down, so I really need this kind of exercise to let go.
Well, as we discussed earlier regarding health issues, it's time to take action.
Yeah, I'm still using the fitness app you recommended last time. It's been quite helpful.

Although running doesn't require any extra expenses, it's best to buy a good pair of running shoes to avoid hurting your feet. I recently bought a nice pair of running shoes and would like to recommend them to you.
It looks really good, and the price is right.
Yes, of course, you can also choose one yourself and pick the one that feels most suitable for you.
Alright, I'll go and take another look, and I'll also carefully consider your recommendations. Is there anything else I need to prepare?
If you're worried about hurting your knees, you can also buy a knee brace.
It should indeed be necessary for me, as I spend a lot of time sitting. By the way, what will be used to track the exercise distance then?
The app I recommended to you before can keep records. It's quite comprehensive, just as convenient as the one we used to track almond therapy check-ins.
Really? That's great, saves the trouble of looking for other tools.
If the two of us persist, we might even be able to participate in a marathon.
Marathon, that's a bit challenging, but I'll stick with it, just like taking care of almonds—slow and steady.
Yes, taking it step by step is fine. So, let's schedule a time to start, like this Saturday morning?
Saturday morning works, but I need to adjust my sleep schedule first—I've been staying up late a bit too much lately.
Well, health comes first, don't push yourself too hard. Just like we said last time when we made plans to eat, find a balance.
Thanks for the reminder, I'll keep that in mind. So, shall we meet at the park entrance at 7 a.m. on Saturday?
Alright, it's settled then.
Looking forward to running together; it feels like this will be a great start.
